svg.title: Two graphs of loss against training epoch, training loss in blue and validation loss in orange. Left, over 100 epochs: training loss falls from about 2.6 to 0.5; validation loss spikes to about 3.25 early, drops to about 0.85 near epoch 20, then levels off near 1.0. Right, over about 190 epochs: training loss falls from 1.0 to nearly 0 by about epoch 110, while validation loss stays near 0.8.
